title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_the_undoing_project_by_michael_lewis_4hde3 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_the_undoing_project_by_michael_lewis_4hde3' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package can lead to full system compromise, including unauthorized access to secrets and keys stored on the affected machine. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets and keys from a separate, uncompromised device is strongly advised.
